description: Use when building a public comps table, benchmarking a private company valuation, or preparing a fundraising benchmark. Public market valuation multiples — EV/EBITDA, EV/Revenue, P/E, and P/S by sector with p25/p50/p75 bands. Source: Damodaran January 2024 dataset. Used for board prep, M&A pricing, fundraising benchmarks, and DCF sanity checks. Free.
name: get_public_market_multiples
